nodes.name: 1. Intake form (Excel / YAML)
nodes.notes: User fills intake_template.xlsx (Bulk / TAGseq / sRNA tab) OR setup_inputs.yaml. Saved to ~/new_project_inbox/<project>/

nodes.name: 2. setup.py -> config.yaml + samples.tsv
nodes.notes: Resolves organism->taxID, reference URLs, OrgDb name, KEGG code; matches FASTQs to metadata; writes the two files the pipeline reads.

nodes.name: 3. submit.sh (auto SLURM tier)
nodes.notes: Counts samples -> picks small (<=20) / medium (21-200) / large (201+) SLURM profile, then launches Snakemake on FARM.

nodes.name: Stage 0: Fetch transcriptome + GTF
nodes.notes: retrieve.smk: curl transcriptome.fa + annotation.gtf from NCBI/Ensembl.

nodes.name: Stage 0b: Build OrgDb (tiered)
nodes.notes: build_orgdb.R: Bioconductor -> cache -> NCBI Gene -> eggNOG. Needed for GO enrichment. Cached per organism.

nodes.name: Stage 1: Per-sample fastp + Salmon  (x N samples)
nodes.notes: 01_qc_quant.sh: fastp clean (SE or PE, --trim_poly_g) -> salmon quant (--gcBias [+seqBias +posBias]) -> quant.sf + metrics.json. One SLURM job per sample.

nodes.name: Stage 1b: QC report (MultiQC + charts)
nodes.notes: qc_report.py: MultiQC report + before/after-clean comparative charts + alignment_summary.tsv + self-contained HTML.

nodes.name: Stage 2: Aggregate -> counts.tsv
nodes.notes: 02_aggregate.R: tximport collapses quant.sf to gene-level counts. Also picks DE backend (edgeR / voom / dream) from sample counts.

nodes.name: Stage 4: GO + KEGG enrichment
nodes.notes: 04_enrichment.R: clusterProfiler GSEA. GO by |t|, KEGG by signed t. Auto-simplify() when >20 sig terms. Needs OrgDb (Stage 0b).

nodes.name: Stage 5: WGCNA co-expression network
nodes.notes: 05_wgcna.R: signed network, auto soft-power, auto module merge. Auto-skipped if <15 samples.

parameters.content:
## RNA-Seq Pipeline — visual map
Read left to right. Each box is one pipeline step. Arrows = data dependencies (what must finish before the next can start). This is a *diagram*, not an executable n8n flow — it mirrors the Snakemake DAG so you can see the whole thing at a glance.

### FRONT DOOR
Fill a form, run one command. Turns your answers into the two files the engine needs, then submits to FARM.

### STAGE 0 — REFERENCE
Fetched + built once per organism. Cached and reused across projects.

### STAGE 1 — PER SAMPLE
Runs in parallel, one SLURM job per sample. QC report fans off here.

### STAGES 2-5 — ANALYSIS
Runs once after all samples quantify. Counts -> DE -> enrichment + network.

main.node: Stage 1: Per-sample fastp + Salmon  (x N samples)
